propositions: Multiple bundle objects exist for a single ref in S3, causing git ls-remote ambiguity, clone hard-failure, and push stall due to git-remote-s3 rejection before bundle write.

git-remote-s3's upstream Doctor.fix_multiple_bundles is interactive-only and discards non-chosen heads, causing permanent data loss of unique events from divergent branches in an append-only event store.

The heal must acquire a shared per-ref S3 lock (via helper's acquire_lock/release_lock), re-enumerate bundles under the lock to guard TOCTOU, fetch all divergent heads locally, and losslessly fold them via iterated 2-parent merges (not octopus), following sync's existing reconcile semantics.

The merged tip is written as a new bundle object before any original is deleted, ensuring at least one bundle carrying full merged history remains at every crash point; originals are deleted only after the merged tip is durable.
On non-derived-file conflict the heal aborts without deleting any remote bundle, releases the lock, and surfaces fsck-recover rather than silencing a parent.

push_tickets_branch detects multi-bundle signatures in stderr via _is_multi_bundle predicate and invokes heal_multi_bundle exactly once (guarded by healed_once flag) before retrying the push, with the S3 lock as outer and rebar's write_lock as inner.
